title: 4 Maguindanao del Norte parliamentary district reps proclaimed

blocks.text: Four parliamentary district representatives in Maguindanao del Norte have been formally proclaimed and Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua is set to be proclaimed Tuesday night as elected representative of the province’s 3rd Parliamentary District.
